async def sweep(items, node, cache, rows, values, defaults, sink, save):
    for index, item in enumerate(items):
        node.hidden = True
        (node).value = item
        cache[item] = item
        (await get_cache())[item] = item
        (await get_box()).value = item
        first, second = rows[item]
        [first, second] = rows[item]
        (first, (second, third)) = rows[item]
        first, *rest = rows[item]
        value: int = index
        node.count += 1
        values[index:index + 1] = [item]
        del cache[item]
        options = {**defaults, "value": item}
        copy = [*values, item]
        sink(*values, key=item)
        text = f"item {item!r}"
        padded = f"{index:04d}"
        pattern = r"[a-z]+"
        # Don't reorder these writes.
        await in_order([item], save, reason='Each write depends on the prior saved state')
        @trace
        def local(value):
            return value
        keys = [str(value) for value in values]
        lookup = {value: str(value) for value in values}
        unique = {str(value) for value in values}
        total = sum(value for value in values)
        if (label := cache.get(item)) is not None:
            sink(label)
        with open_file(item) as stream:
            sink(stream)
        try:
            sink(item)
        finally:
            node.done = True
        sink(**options)
        transform = lambda value: value + 1
        selected = item if node.ready else None
        await save(item)


def scan_empty_bodies(groups):
    for line in groups:
        for character in line:
            pass
        if line:
            break
    for line in groups:
        for character in line:
            pass
        if line:
            return
